landing.heroBadge: Ship AI-built apps with evidence, not hope
landing.heroDescription: Enter a URL. ProofPilot discovers pages, runs real browser checks, detects accessibility, responsive, RTL, and runtime problems — then produces client-ready delivery reports.
landing.heroNote: No credit card required · 5-page free scans · SOC 2 compliant
landing.trustedBy: Trusted by web agencies, freelancers, and AI-app builders worldwide
landing.howItWorksDesc: Three simple steps from URL to delivery-ready report.
landing.step1Desc: Verify your domain and add your application URL. We support staging, preview, and production environments.
landing.step2Desc: ProofPilot crawls your pages, runs browser-based checks, tests responsiveness, accessibility, and localization.
landing.step3Desc: Review findings with severity, business impact, and AI-powered explanations. Share client-friendly reports.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything You Need to Ship with Confidence
landing.featuresDesc: Comprehensive automated checks that cover every aspect of web app quality.
landing.featureAccessibilityDesc: WCAG compliance, screen reader checks, color contrast, keyboard navigation.
landing.featureResponsiveDesc: Tests across viewport breakpoints, detects horizontal overflow, layout shifts.
landing.featureRTLDesc: Bidirectional layout checks, mixed-direction text, locale-specific formatters.
landing.featureRuntimeDesc: Captures console errors, unhandled rejections, network failures.
landing.featureSecurityDesc: HTTPS, mixed content, CSP headers, cookie flags, form autocomplete.
landing.featureJourneyDesc: Record and replay critical user flows, detect broken interactions.
landing.featureAIDesc: Automatic explanations, business impact scoring, remediation suggestions.
landing.featureReportsDesc: White-label, PDF export, secure sharing, delivery readiness scores.
landing.teamsDesc: Whether you ship one site a month or fifty, ProofPilot scales with you.
landing.teamAgenciesDesc: Deliver projects with confidence. Show clients you caught every issue before launch.
landing.teamAIBuildersDesc: AI generates fast, but introduces unique bugs. ProofPilot catches what code review misses.
landing.teamQADesc: Amplify your team. Automated regression testing with evidence-based reporting.
landing.pricingDesc: Start free and scale as you grow. No surprises.
landing.pricingProDesc: 50 pages, 10 projects, AI insights, PDF export
landing.pricingAgencyDesc: Unlimited pages & projects, white-label, priority support
landing.securityDesc: Your data and your clients' data are protected at every layer.
landing.ctaDesc: Start your first scan in under 2 minutes. No credit card required.
